description: UUIDv7 identifier of the consolidated name object.

JSON array of distinct alternative name strings; confirmed spelling errors, incomplete forms, redundant generic forms, identified translations and reviewed historical forms of uncertain validity are excluded.
Detailed feature type, such as stream, canal, lagoon or reservoir.
Source and source_id references for the preferred name only. source=other and source_id=null mean no documented preferred-name source.

One Point location in EPSG:4326 from a source supporting the preferred name. Recorded coordinates take precedence; otherwise a representative point is derived from the original source line or polygon. Alternative-name observation locations and point-selection details remain in the workflow audit.
